records.issue_text: poll_feed.rb can set url to a non-URL feed GUID when blank or not matching http(s) pattern, which later causes URI(url) to raise an uncaught URI::InvalidURIError in absolutize_urls, breaking the whole feed poll for one bad item
records.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, `url` may be replaced with `i.id`, but `TopicEmbed.import` immediately returns unless `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` (first line of the method). That prevents calling `absolutize_urls(url, contents)` and thus prevents `URI(url)` from being executed for non-HTTP(S) GUIDs. So a bad GUID would just be skipped, not crash the poll.
